english.title: Final user of WEEE fail to finance costs of collection, treatment, recovery and financially sound disposal

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the final user of WEEE from a user other than a private household, arising from EEE placed on the market in the United Kingdom before 13th August 2005, when regulation 12(1)(b) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013 did not apply, failed to finance the costs of its collection, treatment, recovery and environmentally sound disposal
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 47(1), 90(8)(a) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the final user of WEEE from a user other than a private household
arising from EEE placed on the market in the United Kingdom before 13th August 2005
when regulation 12(1)(b) did not apply
failed to finance the costs of its collection, treatment, recovery and environmentally sound disposal

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 2 for definitions
(ii) Nothing will prevent a user other than a private household from concluding an agreement with a third party whereby the parties to the agreement make alternative arrangements between themselves to finance the costs of collection, treatment, recovery and environmentally sound disposal of WEEE - regulation 47(2)

other.penalty:
